purpose: During the Phase 2 gold-answer expansion, each benchmark primary provision was grounded against the indexed corpus. Several benchmark qids pair a provision with a title/section that the corpus does not support. This file records those mismatches in machine-readable form so they can be triaged or repaired without re-deriving them. It does not modify benchmark_v1.0.jsonl.

warnings.corpus_evidence: (e) "hazardous substance" means any substance or preparation which, by reason of its chemical or physico-chemical properties or handling, is liable to cause harm to human beings, other living creatures, plant, micro-organism, property or the environment
warnings.recommended_action: Re-point the question to the correct provision/definition, or reword to test the environment-protection power under s3/s6; the Act defines no 'environmentally sensitive area'.

warnings.corpus_actual: power to give directions (closure/prohibition/regulation of industry; stoppage/regulation of a service)
warnings.corpus_evidence: 5. POWER TO GIVE DIRECTIONS ... the power to issue directions under this section includes the power to direct (a) the closure, prohibition or regulation of any industry, operation or process; or (b) stoppage or regulation of the supply of electricity or water or any other service
warnings.recommended_action: Retitle to the directions power, or move the restriction question to the notification/rules regime (s3/s6).
